answer: You can sell your father's car by bringing his death certificate plus either court letters naming you executor or administrator of the estate, or, for a small estate that doesn't go through probate court, the heir and estate affidavit (form NW-EST-1) signed by the heir. If there are several heirs, the executor signs, or every heir signs NW-EST-1. A power of attorney he signed can't be used, because it ended when he died. If there's still a loan on the car the lender holds the title, and if it's paid off but the title is lost you'll need a duplicate title from your state before we can complete the purchase.
